source: AIT Alert Data Set (AIT-ADS) v1, Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.8263181, CC BY 4.0
method: per (scenario, file, alert type, attack phase) groups capped at 1500 alerts, evenly spaced in time; smaller groups kept completely
labels: phase windows from labels.csv; an alert is attack-labelled when its alert type is elevated in the window: count >= 5 x baseline expectation + 1 (baseline = same scenario, same alert type, outside all windows)
